'''Kwymar Automaton Ltd. factory''' was formerly a factory of [[Kwymar Automaton Ltd]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teagan]] before the closure in [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]]. A small group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] used that location to sabotage [[Droid/Legends|droids]], leading to the [[Shadow Raptor revolt]].
